name: Home Assistant, History
description: A numeric Home Assistant sensor over time. Pairs the current value + trend arrow + min/max with a Chart.js line chart, optional threshold horizontal line, min/max marker dots + labels on the curve, and an averaged hourly-profile ghost overlay for long windows. Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: number_format
cell_options.label: Number format
cell_options.help: How the current / min / max values are shown. Blank rounds to 2 decimals and trims trailing zeros (21.00 → 21). Use 0 for whole numbers, 0.0 for one decimal, 0.00 for two, and so on.

cell_options.name: threshold
cell_options.label: Threshold (optional)
cell_options.help: Draws a horizontal dashed line at this value. Useful for 'too cold' / 'too high' / 'over budget' thresholds.

cell_options.name: show_min_max
cell_options.label: Mark min / max points on the chart
